From: Alex Moreno <alex@launchbridge.xyz>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 15:23 -0700
Subject: Quick ask - additional pilot credits?

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the initial pilot credits — we've been ramping into a set of customer demos this week and our usage spiked unexpectedly. We estimate we'll burn through the remaining pilot allotment by the end of this week unless we get a small top-up.

Short ask: can Redwood provide an additional promotional credit to cover ~8k tokens (roughly $5k in usage) for the next 30 days? This will let us finish a second round of demos and complete the internal procurement conversation.

I've attached a compact usage snapshot (CSV) and can share our HubSpot demo tasks if helpful. We're part of the LaunchBridge accelerator cohort and this program has a hard deadline for customer scoping next month.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Moreno
Co-founder, LaunchBridge Inc.
alex@launchbridge.xyz

Alex — appreciated, and congrats on the demo traction.

I'll loop in Monica (account) to validate eligibility and quota availability. Can you also confirm: a) current monthly forecasted token burn, b) demo cadence (how many customer demos this month), and c) whether this needs to be a time-limited promo versus an upgrade/purchase? —Sean

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, Apr 2, 2027 at 09:11 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask - additional pilot credits? (LaunchBridge)

Forwarding Alex's note and the usage snapshot. Proposed internal ask: 8k credits (promo), 30-day extension, require a 1:1 check-in at day 20 and a simple addendum signed (DocuSign) to track promo usage against sales commit.

Deal details: HubSpot DL-2027-0458. I've pulled their usage: current month burn ~2.1M tokens; demo pulse is 6 external demos scheduled over next 3 weeks.

What I need from you, Vivek: quick thumbs up for promotional credit and whether we cap by tokens or dollar value. Finance will want a single-line addendum and the SOC2 excerpt attached for vendor due diligence.

Thanks — Monica

Attachment: launchbridge-usage-snapshot.csv
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask - additional pilot credits? (LaunchBridge)

Monica / Sean,

Approve but with guardrails: authorize a promotional credit of up to $8,000 (applied as 8,000 credit units) for 30 days. Conditions:
- Requires signed promo addendum before additional credits are applied.
- One mandatory check-in (20 days) with the AE to review usage and conversion signal.
- If consumption exceeds the promo cap, auto-transition to pay-as-you-go and we notify the customer 48h prior.

Please assemble the addendum (use promo-addendum-template.pdf), attach SOC2 summary for their security team, and log the approval in HubSpot under DL-2027-0458. Monica, apply provisional 72-hour buffer now to keep demos going, then swap to formal credits once signed.

—Vivek

- Admin: please sign the promo addendum via DocuSign (link below).

- Check-in: schedule a 20-day midpoint review with Monica to confirm conversion signals.
- Overages: if usage will exceed the credit, we'll notify you 48 hours before switching to pay-as-you-go.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=ABCD-2027-0458
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-2027-0458
Drive (usage dashboard): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/launchbridge/usage-dashboard

If that works, sign the addendum and I'll mark the promo live. Let me know if you'd like me to loop a launch engineer for quota smoothing.

Best,
Monica Patel
